<?php
use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;

final class AlarmsTest extends TestCase
{
    private $alarmManager;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        $this->alarmManager = $this->createMock(AlarmManager::class);
    }

    public function testEventLogIncludesAllAlarmOccurrences(): void
    {
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->once())
                   ->method('logAlarmOccurrence')
                   ->with($this->equalTo('alarm occurred'));

        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->once())
                   ->method('logInhibition')
                   ->with($this->equalTo('alarm inhibited'));

        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->once())
                   ->method('logCancellation')
                   ->with($this->equalTo('alarm cancelled'));

        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->once())
                   ->method('logAcknowledgement')
                   ->with($this->equalTo('alarm acknowledged'));

        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(3))
                   ->method('logConsecutiveHighPIP')
                   ->with($this->greaterThanOrEqual(80)->and()->with(10)->and()->with(3000)->and()->inSteps();
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(3))
                   ->method('logLeakageExceedsThreshold')
                   ->with($this->greaterThanOrEqual(5)->and()->with(150)->and()->inSteps();

        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(4))
                   ->method('inhibitAlarm')
                   ->with($this->anything())
                   ->and()->once();
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(4))
                   ->method('acknowledgeAlarm')
                   ->with($this->anything())
                   ->and()->once();
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(3))
                   ->method('cancelAlarm')
                   ->with($this->anything())
                   ->and()->once();

        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(9))
                   ->method('setAlarmOnTidalVolume')
                   ->with($this->greaterThanOrEqual(80)->and()->with(10)->and()->with(3000)->and()->inSteps();
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(9))
                   ->method('setAlarmOnLeakage')
                   ->with($this->greaterThanOrEqual(5)->and()->with(150)->and()->inSteps();
    }

    public function testGUIInhibitsAlarm(): void
    {
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->once())
                   ->method('inhibitAlarm')
                   ->with($this->anything());
    }

    public function testGUIAcknowledgesAlarm(): void
    {
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->once())
                   ->method('acknowledgeAlarm')
                   ->with($this->anything());
    }

    public function testGUICancelsAlarm(): void
    {
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->once())
                   ->method('cancelAlarm')
                   ->with($this->anything());
    }

    public function testAlarmFiresOnHighPIPForThreeConsecutiveBreaths(): void
    {
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(3))
                   ->method('logConsecutiveHighPIP')
                   ->and()->once();
    }

    public function testAlarmFiresOnLeakageExceedingThreshold(): void
    {
        $this->alarmManager->expects($this->exactly(3))
                   ->method('logLeakageExceedsThreshold')
                   ->and()->once();
    }
}
